map.先求竞品均价、去化、产品力的均值，再算自身相对市场的偏离度 =（自身 − 竞品均: First average the competitors' price, absorption and product score, then compute the deviation from the market = (own − competitor average) ÷ competitor average. Price and absorption combinations then drive differentiated response advice.

map.同片区新盘定价前，监测竞品均价、去化率与营销动作。: Before pricing a new project in the same district, monitor competitors' average price, absorption rate and marketing moves.

map.竞品 A 均价 2.8 万/㎡、月去化 65 套；本项目位置略弱，按 2.6 万: Competitor A averages 28,000 yuan/sqm and sells 65 units a month; with a slightly weaker location, pricing this project at 26,000 yuan/sqm plus a fit-out package should match about 60% of that absorption rate.
map.竞品本月 60 套成交中 89㎡ 三居占 55%、119㎡ 四居占 30%，说明: Of the competitor's 60 deals this month, 55% were 89 sqm three-bedroom units and 30% were 119 sqm four-bedroom units, showing first-time upgraders dominate; this project should lead with 89-110 sqm layouts.
map.去化率怎么算才准？: How is the absorption rate calculated correctly?
map.去化率 = 当期认购套数 ÷ 当期有效供应套数，分母要剔除不可售（自持、抵押、工: Absorption rate = units subscribed in the period ÷ effective supply in the period; the denominator must exclude unsaleable units (held for own account, mortgaged, or swapped for construction debt), otherwise the rate is inflated.
map.在售期周度监测价格与销控，月度汇总竞品营销节点和渠道佣金变化。: While on sale, monitor price and sales control weekly; summarize competitors' marketing milestones and channel commission changes monthly.
